title: Tidy a little
intro: Just one small corner. Anything counts, and stopping early is fine.

prompts.text: Clear one cup, plate or bottle from your desk area.
Straighten a single pile of papers or cables.
Wipe your desk surface, just the part near your keyboard.
Water a plant, or just check on it.
Fold one thing and put it away.
Open one drawer and remove just one item that you no longer need.
Put one thing back where it belongs.
Plump up a cushion or tuck in a chair.
Take one bag of rubbish or recycling out.
Tidy one shelf, or even just one shelf edge.
Pick something you like and give it a better spot.
Stop. You have done enough, so sit for a moment.

backAtDesk: Welcome back. Your space looks a little kinder already.
